verdict.rationale: A tax agency with online filing and payment services could plausibly publish developer APIs and SDKs, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only browser-based Online Services, Web File, and Quick Pay, plus a pointer to third-party approved tax software, and none of that is an official SDK. Probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt, or machine-readable docs, so there is no evidence of an official SDK.
